verdict.rationale: Better Auth ships a built-in, configurable rate limiter (docs-11, docs-25, docs-38) which the docs and community both cite as protecting against abuse/brute-force traffic, and community members note rate limiting comes built-in rather than needing to be coded manually (better-auth-comm-11). However, there is no documented CAPTCHA/bot-detection integration, no explicit credential-stuffing detection (e.g., breached-password checks), and no account lockout policy in the evidence pack. missing for 10: explicit bot/CAPTCHA protection, credential-stuffing/breached-password detection, account lockout policy, independent security testing of these defenses.
